statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Tail remains low; macro and Nvidia keep Stress elevated.
recommendation: Tail remains below the block threshold; the principal checkpoints are the 08:30 ET data cluster, the U.S. cash open and Nvidia.
headline: Low Tail, high catalyst Stress
body: Tuesday technology and semiconductor shares rebounded while Treasury yields and oil fell. Overnight futures are mildly softer, but current evidence does not establish persistent one-way NQ structure. Wednesday macro data and Nvidia create high event Stress.

lookbackSummary: Tail stayed low through Tuesday apart from one unavailable 06:00 UTC slot; the latest published assessments shifted from mixed to normal late in the session.
outlookSummary: Stress rises sharply into the 12:30 UTC U.S. data cluster and cash open, then again around Nvidia results and its conference call. Tail remains conditional on persistent one-way price structure and failed mean reversion.

forecast.analysis: Overnight Nasdaq futures are mildly softer after Tuesday's technology-led rebound, but current evidence does not show persistent one-way NQ structure. Tail stays low while Wednesday's macro and Nvidia catalysts keep Stress elevated.

news.title: Wall Street ends higher as tech rebounds before Nvidia results

forecast.analysis: With no major U.S. release in this hour, the key condition is whether overnight weakness remains two-way. Tail would rise only if pullbacks become shallow or repeatedly fail.
Early Asia remains a structure check rather than an event window. Orderly retracement would keep Tail low; repeated extension toward session extremes would be the contrary signal.
Mid-Asia is relatively low-catalyst. A larger move by itself would mainly raise Stress unless it becomes directionally efficient and resists meaningful retracement.
Late-Asia liquidity can amplify headlines. Tail remains low-to-moderate conditionally unless price holds near an extreme and failed retracements begin to stack.
The Europe transition adds liquidity and cross-asset information. Broader alignment in yields, volatility and semiconductors would matter only if it reinforces persistent NQ direction.
European cash trade can validate or reject the overnight move. Conflicting cross-assets would favor Stress over Tail; synchronized confirmation with failed pullbacks would raise Tail.
Pre-U.S. positioning becomes more sensitive as the 08:30 ET data cluster approaches. Event importance raises Stress, while Tail still depends on observed directional persistence.
Macro anticipation can widen ranges before the release. No outcome is known yet, so forecast Tail remains conditional on the structure already visible into the data.
Dispersion may rise ahead of GDP, Personal Income/PCE and durable goods. A pre-release drift is not enough for elevated Tail without shallow retracements and cross-asset confirmation.
Positioning risk increases two hours before the data cluster. Tail remains below block territory unless NQ is already showing sustained extension and failed mean reversion.
One hour before the 08:30 ET releases, gap and whipsaw risk rises sharply. Stress is high; Tail remains conditional on the actual post-release price path.
The GDP, Personal Income/PCE and durable-goods releases hit at 12:30 UTC. Tail is forecast in WATCH territory because a persistent post-release path is possible, not because any outcome is known.

The first post-data hour is the most important structure test. Tail could remain in WATCH if price discovery is one-way with shallow pullbacks; orderly retracement would argue for rapid normalization.
The U.S. cash open can reinforce or reverse the data move. Continued session-extreme holding with broad confirmation would sustain Tail; two-way auction would reduce it.
After the initial cash-open impulse, Tail should ease if volatility decays and retracements normalize. Failed retracements would keep the window active longer.
Midday structure matters more than the size of the morning move. Persistent extension would keep Tail elevated; balanced trade would shift risk back toward Stress.
Afternoon event sensitivity starts rebuilding ahead of Nvidia. Tail remains low unless the cash session has already developed efficient one-way structure.
Late-session positioning can become more directional before Nvidia, but the earnings outcome is still unknown. Stress rises faster than Tail in the absence of observed persistence.
The final cash-session hour can amplify positioning and index concentration. Tail moves to WATCH only if trend efficiency and cross-asset confirmation strengthen into the close.
Nvidia is expected to publish results around 20:20 UTC. The event can create a large gap, but before the result Tail remains a conditional WATCH rather than an assumed one-way repricing.
drivers: No result known at forecast cutoff

forecast.analysis: Nvidia's 21:00 UTC conference call adds a second information wave after the result. A sustained first move plus reinforcing guidance/Q&A and failed retracements would be the key Tail mechanism.
Post-call repricing can remain volatile. Tail eases if the first reaction retraces and cross-assets stabilize; a delayed second leg would keep WATCH conditions active.
Late-evening liquidity can exaggerate residual post-earnings moves. Tail is expected to ease if price discovery becomes two-way and no new catalyst reinforces the direction.
